title: Ukubwa na Udogo wa Nomino (Theme 11: Uwekezaji)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child makes the big form with ji- (mtoto -> jitoto) and the small form with ki- (mtoto -> kitoto) for m- nouns with a two-syllable root, and changes the agreement to LI-YA or KI-VI.
representations: drawings: an ordinary, a huge and a tiny child
steps: Check the root has two syllables.
contexts: investment: a big shop and a small kiosk
a folk tale with a giant

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "jikono" and "kikono" with a sentence for each.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Udogo wa "mtoto" ni ___." Kwa nini "jitoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ki- huonyesha udogo (kitoto, kijiji) na ji- huonyesha ukubwa (jitoto, jiji).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ukubwa wa "mtoto" ni ___." Kwa nini "jimtoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: M- ya mwanzo huondolewa kabla ya kuongeza kiambishi cha ukubwa au udogo: mtoto - jitoto, kitoto.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Udogo wa "mji" ni ___." Kwa nini "kimji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino zenye shina la silabi moja zinaongeza ji- kabla ya ki-: mji - kijiji, mto - kijito, mti - kijiti.

misconceptions.ask: Kitoto kiko katika ngeli ipi sasa?
misconceptions.repair: Udogo huchukua upatanisho wa KI-VI: kitoto kinalia.
